- "Ko-fi.com" <Ko-fi@ko-fi.com> — Alan Walton, someone supported you on Ko-fi! ☕️🎉 [everything-else]
- "amazon.com" <order-update@amazon.com> — Delivery update: "Renaissance Shirt Women..." and 3 more items [amazon-other]

Each rule's own `# Rule` section says what it asks; the mail is still in the inbox.
